relationships.subject: pannexin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: In male rodents, Panx1 drives vascular endothelial growth factor-A (VEGF-A) release from microglia.

relationships.subject: pannexin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Leptin release from female-derived CD8<sup>+</sup> T cells was Panx1 dependent

relationships.subject: CD8+ T cells
relationships.evidence_quote: Adoptive transfer of female-derived CD8<sup>+</sup> T cells caused robust allodynia

key_findings: Panx1 in microglia drives VEGF-A-dependent allodynia in males; Panx1 in CD8+ T cells drives leptin-dependent allodynia in females.
